description: Figure 3b illustrates BLEU scores as a function of epochs during training. The x-axis is labeled “Epochs”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 3.0, and has tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU score”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 0.35, and has tick marks at intervals of 0.05. There are three lines displayed: a solid blue line representing “regular members”, a solid orange line representing “members with near-duplicates”, and a dashed yellow line representing “held-out data”. The blue line begins at approximately 0.06 at an epoch of 0, increases to 0.16 at an epoch of 3.0. The orange line begins at approximately 0.12 at an epoch of 0, increases to 0.23 at an epoch of 3.0. The yellow line begins at approximately 0.18 at an epoch of 0, increases to 0.26 at an epoch of 3.0.
